readme: Triage for `npm run audit:spoilers`. Each entry is a hit that was read and is not a leak to fix in src/data.
An entry with no `key` matches the term on every card; one with `key` (and `field`) matches only there.
fp     - not a leak: the name is on the page of the book the card is gated on, or it is an ordinary word.
minor  - a name from a later book with no plot attached (a city, a Dominance, a Word of Brandon cameo). Kept on purpose.
leak   - a real leak in a file this pass does not own (catalog.ts, ShardEra). Reported; delete the entry once it is fixed there.
ui     - a leak the data cannot gate: field notes and a magic's Shard field have no gate of their own. Reported.
A real leak in data the sweep's owner can reach is fixed, not listed. Stale entries are reported on every run.
